content.title: Buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A
content.statement: Buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A; supplier B is rejected for this season.
content.context: Choosing a supplier for the drip irrigation kit.
content.rationale: Supplier A guarantees delivery before the April planting; supplier B could not commit to a delivery date.
alternatives: Buy the kit from supplier B
content.impacts: The irrigation can be installed before the April planting.

evidence: the group agreed to buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A, because they guarantee delivery before the April planting.
Supplier B is rejected for this season.
